name: Hajmáskér (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hajmáskér (a green and red shield with a vine, a sheaf of grain and a cannon) below the name HAJMÁSKÉR in red.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
